name: @narduk-enterprises/libs-explorer
description: Narduk Libs Explorer: a browsable showcase of the workspace's components, foundations and package catalog.

scripts.typecheck: nuxt typecheck && tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --target ES2022 --allowImportingTsExtensions --allowJs --types node inventory/*.mts demo/*.mts scripts/*.mts
scripts.quality: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit
